name: Hitaki Mashiro
source:
Mashiro can be found in many places cheering people on in an attempt to brighten their day, all the while dragging [url=/c98267]Nana[/url] with her. Trivial things do not bother her, but she is prone to breaking into tears whenever something does get to her. Mashiro wishes to bring smiles to the whole school alongside her juniors.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
